text: DSH Chat 为 DSH Web 提供本地及跨主机群聊，让人和 DSH 会话加入持久房间。它在会话视图加入时间线、成员选择器和消息编辑器，并注册创建、加入、邀请会话及发送消息的工具。用户可选择特定会话或全体接收消息，管理房间成员并在 Chatrooms 工作区恢复房间。适合需要多人和多个智能体协作交流的团队。本地使用需要 dsh-bridge 与会话持久化服务；跨主机成员还需配对 dsh-weave。

DSH Chat adds persistent rooms to DSH Web for local or paired sessions. Its timeline and member picker work with tools to create rooms, invite sessions, and send messages to recipients or everyone. Local rooms need dsh-bridge and session persistence; remote members need paired dsh-weave hosts.
想让几个 DSH 会话在同一个房间里聊天。
能不能把其他本地会话邀请进群聊？
我需要一个能保存聊天记录并在 DSH 界面查看的房间。
让群消息只通知我选中的智能体会话。
I want a shared chat room for several DSH sessions.
Can I message a session on a paired DSH host from the same room?
DSH Chat 的功能「创建和加入房间」：通过工具按名称创建群聊并让当前会话加入，也能按房间名或 ID 加入已有本地房间。房间会成为 Chatrooms 工作区中的持久会话。
DSH Chat 的功能「选择成员投递」：在房间编辑器选择成员别名或会话 ID 后发送消息；代码按结构化 mentions 投递，不从消息正文解析提及。也可选全体成员。
DSH Chat 的功能「跨主机房间」：房间成员选择器可浏览已配对主机的工作区和会话，并将远程会话加入房间；投递通过 dsh-weave 传送。该能力依赖两端配对配置。
DSH Chat 的功能「房间消息界面」：在 DSH 会话视图显示房间时间线、成员和聊天编辑器，并轮询新消息；界面支持中英文标签以及成员状态展示。
有没有办法把已配对的另一台主机上的 DSH 会话加进房间？
I need persistent chat rooms that appear as sessions in the web interface.
dsh-chat README · Introduction：

dsh-chat README · DSH Chat：[English](README.md) · [简体中文](README.zh.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-chat) [](LICENSE) [](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) Bring people and DSH agents into shared rooms. Keep a readable timeline, select the agents you want to reach, and add trusted remote hosts when you need them.

dsh-chat README · A room with clear delivery：| In the room | What happens |
| --- | --- |
| Send a normal message | It appears in the shared timeline. |
| Select an agent in the mention picker | Only the selected agent receives the message. |
| Select `@all` | All eligible room agents receive it. |
| Add a remote member | The room uses an explicitly paired Weave host. |

Typing an email address or a literal `@alias` does not wake an agent. Delivery uses the separate, structured mention selection.

dsh-chat README · Quick start：```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bridge@latest dsh-chat@latest
dsh web
```

1. Ask an agent to create a chat room, for example: “Create a group chat called Release.”
2. Open the room in the **Chatrooms** workspace.
3. Use the member drawer to choose a **Host → Workspace → Session**.
4. Write a message and select mentions when an agent should receive it.

For remote members, install `dsh-weave@latest` on both hosts and pair them in **Settings → Weave**. Local rooms work without Weave.

dsh-chat README · Designed for everyday conversations：- A dedicated room composer and authoritative timeline inside the normal DSH session view.
- Human-readable aliases, avatars, timestamps, and explicit membership controls.
- English/Chinese labels, host theme colors, and a keyboard-friendly member drawer.
- Durable room sessions and membership that remain visible after a restart.
- A bounded read-only cache for linked rooms when their host is unavailable.

dsh-chat README · Agent tools：| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `chat_create` | Create a named room. |
| `chat_join` | Join a room. |
| `chat_invite` | Invite a session to the room. |
| `chat_send` | Send a room message with explicit mentions. |

An agent's ordinary reply remains in its own session. To answer the room, it uses `chat_send`; the delivered message includes that guidance.

dsh-chat README · How the pieces fit：```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Human[You] --> Chat[DSH Chat room]
  Chat --> Bridge[Bridge · local agents]
  Chat --> Weave[Weave · trusted hosts]

Each room has one authoritative host. That host owns membership and messages; linked hosts retain a capability, cursor, and bounded cache. Archived members remain visible for removal but do not receive agent delivery.

dsh-chat README · How the pieces fit：Cancelled operations stop waiting and stop sending to further recipients. Already committed room state and delivered messages remain. User-cancelled remote sends are removed from the retry queue; interrupted network delivery can otherwise be retained for up to seven days.

dsh-chat README · Configuration：| Field | Default |
| --- | --- |
| `path` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-chat/rooms.json` |
| `workspacePath` | `$DSH_HOME/dsh-chat/Chatrooms` |

`DSH_HOME` defaults to `~/.dsh`. Room state uses owner-only file permissions. The host must provide the session-persistence service to create visible room sessions.

dsh-chat README · Current scope：Rooms and explicit delivery are available today. Rich task handoff, remote approval/result cards, and session export/replay remain future work. [Bridge](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-bridge) owns local delivery; [Weave](https://github.com/baixianger/dsh-weave) owns cross-host transport.
